\[
\gamma_R(f) = R^{\delta}_f(f \ominus B)
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(B\): The structuring element
- \(R^{\delta}_f\): Reconstruction by dilation under f

The erosion removes every bright object the element does not fit into. Reconstruction by dilation under the image then brings back every object that kept at least one pixel, with its exact shape. A plain opening would round the corners of those objects instead.
